description: Add, update, or remove a static IPv6 address on a MikroTik router interface, including EUI-64 and DHCPv6-PD pool (fromPool) addresses. Idempotent by address and interface: an identical add returns already_exists, an update with nothing to change returns no_change. Addresses are compared in canonical form. Dynamic addresses are refused. Supports dry-run for all actions.

action.description: Action to perform: add, update, or remove an IPv6 address

address.description: IPv6 address with prefix length, e.g. 2001:db8::1/64. With eui64, a prefix such as 2001:db8:1::/64 (the interface ID is generated). With fromPool, the interface-ID suffix such as ::1/64 (the prefix comes from the pool).

advertise.description: Advertise this prefix in router advertisements (SLAAC); omit to keep RouterOS's default

comment.description: Optional comment for the address entry

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

disabled.description: Whether the address should be disabled

dryRun.description: If true, validate and return planned changes without applying

eui64.description: Generate the last 64 bits from the interface MAC (EUI-64); the prefix length must be 64 or shorter

fromPool.description: IPv6 pool (e.g. one filled by DHCPv6 prefix delegation) that supplies the prefix; address then gives only the suffix

interface.description: Interface the address is assigned to

noDad.description: Skip duplicate address detection; omit to keep RouterOS's default (DAD on)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_ipv6_address
title: Manage IPv6 Address
